title: Decision: attachment links: a per-blob HMAC URL with expiry on the agent's HTTP listener (agent choice, epic mimid-qqtk)
description: Epic mimid-qqtk item 5. GET /attachment/<blobId>/<expires>/<mac>/<name>; mac = first 16 octets of HMAC-SHA256(link key, 'mimid-attachment-link-v1' 0 blobId 0 expires), hex; link key = HMAC-SHA256(local token, 'mimid-attachment-link-key-v1'), so a new token revokes all links. Host check as for every request; the link's MAC replaces the bearer token on this path only: a second authorization at the agent boundary (AGENTS.md table row added). Default lifetime 24 h, max 30 days (INVENTED). Served only while a non-deleted message names the blob. Supersedes for IRC v2 the no-new-authorization part of agent-frontends.md §7.4 (v1 IRC still shows no attachments). Doc: agent-frontends.md §7.30.
